primitives.meaning: an activated account failing to progress against the usage pattern this product actually intends
entryFilters: the expected adoption pattern for this use-case was not met, measured against the product's own rhythm
the account is active and not terminated, restricted or in a live risk case
no recovery instance is already open for this account and use-case

primitives.does: Work out what the evidence actually shows: setup that was never finished, an integration that is missing, no clear next use-case, collaborators who never joined, value that simply never repeated, a technical blocker - or a use-case that is finished and needs nothing further

branches.label: Recoverable blocker
branches.test: something specific is in the way: unfinished setup, a missing integration, an unclear next use-case, collaborators who never arrived

branches.label: Needs a person
branches.test: a technical problem that will not be solved by a message

branches.label: Need genuinely met
branches.test: the use-case was completed and there is nothing further to do - the account got what it came for

branches.label: No evidence of a problem
branches.test: usage looks light against a generic expectation but nothing indicates anything is wrong

primitives.state: use-case complete; the need was met, not abandoned
primitives.reEntry: a new use-case, or the same need arising again, opens adoption normally - this account did not fail, it finished

competition.precedence: lowest in the group - an open issue under human ownership, a live risk case or a declared cancellation intent all outrank a recovery nudge

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the blocker needs an explanation that survives until the person can act on it
a valid token exists and the blocker is a single step the person can take from the notification

primitives.purpose: Address the diagnosed blocker specifically - the unfinished setup, the missing integration, the misunderstanding. Not more encouragement and not a re-run of onboarding.
primitives.brief: Address the diagnosed blocker specifically. Not more encouragement, not a re-run of onboarding - the thing the diagnosis actually named
